dates.text: certio non julii anno à nativitate Domini millesimo quadrige esimo quadragesimostro

data.summary: Dispensation for Stephen Paveti Mochus to retain the priorate of the Monastery of Saint Sugedi despite his minority (age 16), following the resignation of the priorate by Ludovicus de Grateur and the subsequent transfer of the beneficiary to the Monastery of Saint Michael of Clusa.
